en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, form Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Chose something from everything. He<sup>azwj</sup> Chose the she-camel from the camels, and from the sheep, the ewe’.
en.sarwar: 11. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:

“I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has chosen something from everything and from camels, He has chosen she-camels and from sheep He has chosen ewes.’”
